purpose: Track optional or deferred modules that are intentionally retained but must not silently become permanent complexity.

modules.rationale: Cloud/distributed scheduler authority remains deferred. LocalSchedulerLeaseArbiter is the default local-first path.
modules.keep_condition: Retain only if explicit cluster-on work resumes or external control-plane failover becomes a concrete roadmap item.
modules.delete_condition: Delete or quarantine if cluster mode remains unused through the review date and the owner confirms cloud/distributed scheduling is still deferred.

modules.rationale: Remote worker support is useful for future distributed execution but the current product remains personal local-first.
modules.keep_condition: Retain if M73-M75 introduces a bounded AutomationLease or worker-pool deployment plan that uses it.
modules.delete_condition: Delete or move behind a plugin boundary if no bounded remote execution plan exists by the review date.

modules.rationale: External worker pools are opt-in and should not affect the default local execution path.
modules.keep_condition: Retain if there is fresh evidence for callback allowlist, shared secret, lease, and partial failure resume behavior.
modules.delete_condition: Quarantine or remove if they remain unused and unverified by the review date.
